exposure: Implementation level of the Ten Steps to Successful Breastfeeding
outcome: Implementation level of the Ten Steps to Successful Breastfeeding
Barriers to implementing the Ten Steps
cohort: Nurse managers of birthing and maternity units in 43 Mississippi hospitals that provide birthing and maternity care
finding: The implementation level of the Ten Steps to Successful Breastfeeding in Mississippi hospitals was moderate in 29% and partial in 71%, with barriers including resistance to new policies, limited resources, and lack of government support.
